# Fieldwork

> One TypeScript API for web and image search, page reading, value extraction, product data, site maps, crawls, cited answers, research, entity discovery, closed-question decisions, monitors, remote browsers and document parsing across Exa, Firecrawl, Tavily, Parallel, Perplexity, Brave, SerpApi, Browserbase, LlamaParse and Reducto. Each instance has only the methods its provider offers; nothing falls back to another provider. Published as @howells/fieldwork-sdk, with an MCP server as @howells/fieldwork-mcp.

## Packages

- [@howells/fieldwork-sdk README](https://github.com/howells/fieldwork/blob/main/packages/fieldwork-sdk/README.md): installation, the capability table by provider, results, shared options, results and `meta`, long jobs, monitors and browsers, the router, errors and recovery, agent tools, keys.
- [@howells/fieldwork-mcp README](https://github.com/howells/fieldwork/blob/main/packages/fieldwork-mcp/README.md): running the MCP server, choosing providers per capability, client configuration, the tool list.

## Reference

- [Capabilities by provider](https://github.com/howells/fieldwork/blob/main/packages/fieldwork-sdk/README.md#capabilities): which of the 17 capabilities each of the ten providers offers, and the shared option names.
- [Errors](https://github.com/howells/fieldwork/blob/main/packages/fieldwork-sdk/README.md#errors): the nine error codes, what each means and what to do, `retryable`, `retryAfter` and `jobId`.
- [Agent tools](https://github.com/howells/fieldwork/blob/main/packages/fieldwork-sdk/README.md#agent-tools): `toolsFor()` tool definitions with JSON Schema inputs and outputs, for the AI SDK and other frameworks.
- [Result types](https://github.com/howells/fieldwork/blob/main/packages/fieldwork-sdk/src/types.ts): the normalized shapes every adapter returns.

## Contributing

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/howells/fieldwork/blob/main/AGENTS.md): commands, rules, boundaries and how to add an adapter.
